g.text: This procedure is a variation of the forward solution procedure.
The procedure for selecting predictor variables is similar to the forward
solution procedure except that after each predictor variable is selected, a
second significance test is conducted to determine the contribution of each
predictor variable before it (the predictor variable which has been placed
in the regression model) with the assumption that it is the final variable
